# `time-transfer-budget`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.39.0, family [Clocks, timing and holdover](../clocks-timing-and-holdover.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Two-way satellite time and frequency transfer between two stations through a geostationary relay: the two-way equation solved for T_A - T_B with every non-reciprocal term (station equipment delays, Ku-band ionosphere, transponder, Sagnac), a quadrature uncertainty budget whose type A term is the simulated link's TDEV at the averaging time, a simulated link with white and flicker phase noise and a diurnal non-reciprocity, and the stability (rate, residual RMS, TDEV, ADEV) of any supplied BIPM Circular T Section 1 series, MJD,ns CSV or IGS RINEX station-clock records. MODELLED.

One run of `scenarios/time-transfer-budget.toml` summarises as: time-transfer-budget: europe - north-america offset 12.500 ns (Sagnac 204.365 ns, ionosphere 0.0213 ns); combined u 1.087 ns (type A 0.031 ns at 86400 s); 0 real series (MODELLED)
